Bnei Yehuda Tel Aviv F.C., commonly referred to as Bnei Yehuda, is an Israeli football club from the Hatikva Quarter of the city of Tel Aviv. The club is a member of the Liga Leumit. Founded in 1936, the team plays its home matches at the Hatikva Neighborhood Stadium.
